C1319.title: Volt Typhoon Uses Living off the Land to Attack
C1319.summary: In May 2023, international cybersecurity agencies issued an advisory on Volt Typhoon, a China state-sponsored hacking group. The group targets U.S. critical infrastructure by employing Living off the Land techniques, disguising malicious commands as normal administrative activity to evade endpoint detection and response, and attempting to steal Active Directory database files.
